title: zupmxode 0.0.0.9000
text: Initial CRAN submission. pmx_ode_tier() reports sets tier model runs : native code generated MIR, MIR’s interpreter. pmx_ode_model() compiles model written subset rxode2’s model language described documentation, including linCmt(). pmx_ode_events() builds NONMEM-style event table doses observation times. pmx_ode_solve() solves closed-form models (linCmt()) one subjects, exactly, time-varying covariates, resets steady state. pmx_ode_solve() solves models closed form, LSODA (bundled liblsoda) Dormand-Prince 5(4). Linear models solved exactly events matrix exponential. pmx_ode_method() reports sets model’s solver; pmx_ode_info() says model , solver takes , tier long took compile. Subjects solved parallel OpenMP; pmx_ode_threads() sets many threads, one default. Results , bit bit, thread count. pmx_ode_tier() keeps model’s compartments, outputs solver makes copy another tier. pmx_ode_sim() simulates population: etas drawn omega, residual error add(), prop(), add() + prop() lnorm(), every draw made R’s random number generator, set.seed() makes simulation reproducible thread count. pmx_ode_solve() reads NONMEM’s MDV table EVID: record dose MDV 1 marks time rather observation.
